title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you’ll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

- You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

- Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.

- Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.

- Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.

- Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.

- Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.

- Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.

- Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.

- Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.

- Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment — not a single product or team's slice of it.

- Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.

- Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.

- Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.

- Strong AWS cloud services background.

- Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).

- Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.

- Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.

- Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.

- Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).

- Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.

- Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.

- Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.

- Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Senior Developer Experience Writer
description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

About this role 

Thousands of developers around the world use Ably's SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to.

As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture.

This is a modern take on technical writing; you’ll be using AI to both increase your own output, whilst also increasing the velocity of other contributors. The same core values still apply though - ensuring that users can quickly understand and succeed with Ably.

Day to day you will 

- Use AI to produce quality content. You’ll write reusable prompts and skills that docs contributors can use to ensure their content meets Ably’s quality standards. 

- Define and uphold content standards . You'll help define what great looks like; from docs structure and style to making sure that PRs are always exceeding standards. You’ll leverage AI to check for technical accuracy, and make sure that content always assists developers in learning and succeeding with Ably in the fastest and easiest ways possible.

- Build engaging educational content templates. You’ll lead by example by producing reference content that others can use as a pattern to write similar content. This will be in the format of templates and skills that team members can leverage.

- Empower engineers to write great content . You'll coach and support engineering contributors to ensure that they’re always producing accurate, well-structured, developer-friendly content.

- Champion effective AI use . You'll promote the use of AI for efficiency, while maintaining a sharp eye for quality ensuring content meets editorial standards, is technically accurate, and is free from AI-generated patterns that undermine trust or clarity.

- Maintain and elevate the docs platform . You'll take responsibility for shaping the documentation platform's components, structure and tooling. This includes making sure content is logically structured, and easily navigable, and that it helps external developers understand Ably in new and exciting ways. 

We'd love to talk if you have 

- Proven success creating technical content for developers, such as documentation, API references and guides; with a portfolio that others have visibly learned from.

- Experience reviewing and giving feedback on technical writing, with the ability to coach others to improve their craft.

- Experience and a desire to work in an AI-forward environment. Experience in automation, working with agents and producing quality content at scale is a bonus.

- Experience of using AI tools as a core part of your workflow for writing, research and coding, as well as understanding their output and limitations.

- Familiarity with APIs, SDKs, and modern web development tools, with the ability to read, write and reason about code examples in at least one programming language (ideally JavaScript).

- Result-oriented, ability to multi-task

- Experience with customer engagements a plus, but not a requirement

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. - Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary 

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do 

- Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

- Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

- Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

- Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications 

- Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.

- Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.

- An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

- Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive .

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values 

- Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

- Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

- Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

- Own it and get it done. Results matter!

- Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

- Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

- Experience designing lightweight carbon-fibre composite structures, including laminate design and sandwich panels and knowledge of composite manufacturing methods and processes

- Experience designing parts for polymer 3D printed components, with a practical understanding of print orientation and load paths

- Ability to perform hand calculations and correlate analytical results with FEA and structural test data

- Strong communication and multidisciplinary collaboration skills across aerodynamics, systems and manufacturing teams

- Experience with aeroelasticity analysis, including flutter, divergence, structural deflection, and vibration assessment, would be a strong advantage

Team-Events und Mitarbeiterfrühstück gehören bei uns genauso dazu, wie der kleine Plausch in der Küche, denn stärken wir das Wir-Gefühl und wachsen weiter zusammen.

Um für die täglichen Herausforderungen gewappnet zu sein und den Geschäftserfolg nachhaltig zu stärken, glauben wir nicht nur an Expertise und Erfahrung. Ce poste est basé à Paris (France) et requiert que le candidat retenu réside déjà à Paris ou soit prêt à s'y installer. La maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais (à l'oral comme à l'crit) est indispensable pour ce poste.

Actuellement, nous ne sommes pas en mesure de proposer de parrainage de visa (sponsorship) pour ce poste. Nous nous engageons à bâtir une équipe diversifiée et internationale, et notre politique de parrainage est évaluée au cas par cas. Nous vous encourageons à suivre notre page carrières pour rester informé des futures opportunités pour lesquelles un parrainage de visa serait possible.

Kaluza est une plateforme d'intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité du secteur en une coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l'énergie à surmonter les défis actuels tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. En nous appuyant sur les données, l'IA et la prise de décision en temps réel, nous transformons cette complexité énergétique en opportunités de croissance pour nos partenaires. 

En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l'humain (human-centered design), Kaluza rend l'énergie propre fiable et abordable. 

Avec des équipes réparties en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Asie et en Australie, ainsi qu'une coentreprise avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous propulsons des leaders du secteur tels qu'OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des pionniers comme Volvo et Volkswagen. 

Quelles seront mes missions? 

Piloter la localisation de notre plateforme mondiale de facturation d’énergie, en veillant à ce qu’elle réponde aux exigences réglementaires, de marché et culturelles spécifiques de la France, du relevé de compteur à la facture. Vous serez en charge de la localisation française du module de facturation, l’un des domaines produit centraux au cœur de la plateforme Kaluza, responsable de conduire un client du relevé de compteur à la facture. Le module de facturation consomme les données de consommation, de tarification et de compte pour planifier, calculer et générer des factures exactes, émises dans les délais et conformes, tout au long du cycle de vie du client. Le module gère automatiquement les cycles de facturation, génère les factures, traite les corrections et produit les données qui alimentent les factures, les communications liées à la facturation, les échéanciers de paiement, le reporting financier en aval, ainsi que les interfaces clients et agents. C’est un rôle produit full-stack, très concret : vous travaillerez sur l’ensemble du domaine, aux côtés des PM des autres domaines et des équipes de facturation globales, pour vous assurer que le parcours de facturation global, du compteur à la facture, répond aux exigences des clients français.

- Collaborer intensément avec les clients et les experts locaux pour comprendre leurs besoins et exigences spécifiques, négocier le périmètre et construire une roadmap.

- Plonger dans les réglementations du marché français de l’énergie, en traduisant des besoins de conformité complexes en spécifications produit détaillées pour le système de facturation.

- Définir et gérer des exigences produit détaillées pour les fonctionnalités liées aux besoins spécifiques au pays, de l’obtention d’un relevé à la génération d’une facture (protocoles de relevé de compteur, formats de facture, règles de taxation, modes de paiement et reporting réglementaire).

- Travailler étroitement avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’UX et de test (qualité) pour assurer la réussite de la mise en œuvre et des tests des fonctionnalités de facturation localisées.

- Agir en tant qu’expert de référence pour les équipes globales sur les spécificités du marché français liées à la facturation d’énergie et aux parcours clients.

- Surveiller en continu les évolutions de la législation et des pratiques du marché français de l’énergie, en adaptant de manière proactive la roadmap produit pour maintenir la conformité et la compétitivité.

Idéalement, vous avez / vous êtes: 

- Une expérience avérée de Product Manager, ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des entreprises de logiciels, avec un solide historique de réussite dans la localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.

- Une compréhension solide du cycle de vie de facturation B2C de bout en bout, y compris les données de comptage, les tarifs, la facturation et la gestion de la dette.

- Une expérience dans des marchés régulés où la complexité de la facturation compte : énergie, télécoms, services financiers ou équivalent. Une familiarité avec le marché français de l’énergie (ENGIE, CRE, changement de fournisseur, structures tarifaires) est un avantage.

- Une capacité exceptionnelle à traduire des textes réglementaires abstraits ou des exigences clients en exigences claires, actionnables et orientées résultats pour les équipes de développement.

- Une expérience de collaboration avec des équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, juridique, opérations, réussite client) pour livrer des solutions localisées.

- D’excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et des clients, capable de mener les discussions sur les exigences, le périmètre, les attentes et l’alignement de la roadmap, et de communiquer clairement la complexité technique et de marché à des publics variés.

- La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la découverte et l’idéation à la livraison et l’itération.

- Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur : vous êtes autonome, vous apprenez vite et vous n’avez pas peur d’aller en profondeur. Vous êtes à l’aise pour interroger une base de code avec des outils d’IA, lire un schéma d’API ou un modèle de données, et écrire une requête SQL pour obtenir la réponse dont vous avez besoin.

- À l’aise avec l’ambiguïté et le rythme : vous pouvez travailler efficacement quand tout n’est pas défini, vous savez quand trancher, et vous n’avez pas peur d’escalader ou de demander de l’aide quand c’est important.

- Courant en français et très à l’aise en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre.

Kaluza Values 

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business: 

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together 

We want the best people 

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn .

title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch) 

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht 

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check 

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du… 

- … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst , die es wirklich braucht.

- … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren. 

- … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest .

- … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht .

- … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben . Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du 

Worum geht es? 

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist? 

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI? 

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben? 

- Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

- Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

- Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

- Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support 

- Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

- Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann.

- Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik.

Was bringst du mit? 

- 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

- Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

- Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB.

- Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

- Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss 

- Erfahrung mit WordPress.

- Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch.

- Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden.

Rahmenbedingungen 

- Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes

- Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb

- Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht.

- Zeitraum: ab sofort

Interesse? 

Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung.

Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr.

Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima.

Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung.

Unser Team, deine Vorteile 

Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt.

Das sind unsere Vorteile:

- Fort- und Weiterbildung

- Family Life Balance

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- Homeoffice

- Freiwillige Sozial­leistungen

- Urban Sports Club

Lust auf mehr? Unser Team stellt sich dir gerne persönlich vor.

description:

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
Help shape the future of robotics in construction. 

ABOUT XYZ REALITY 

XYZ Reality created the world’s first and only engineering-grade augmented reality solution, purpose-built for the construction industry. Our holographic technology sits within The Atom, a smart, site-safe headset and hardhat, and is used on live projects to ensure schemes are delivered on time and on budget.

XYZ has grown to over 150 staff across the UK, US and Europe, and works with mission-critical organisations and construction companies to deliver major projects.

THE ROLE 

Construction sites are some of the hardest environments for robot autonomy: they change every day and are full of clutter, obstacles and people. XYZ Reality’s robotics programme is extending our technology toward robots that can operate reliably in them, from autonomous data collection and construction progress capture through to executing construction tasks.

We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to make that real. You’ll work hands-on with robot hardware in our London office, using a modern stack (ROS 2, NVIDIA Isaac Lab, learning-based control), and see your work tested in real construction environments, not just in simulation.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on robot software and algorithmic control, backed by a good working knowledge of robot hardware. If you have strong robotics fundamentals from an MSc, PhD or applied research group, love making systems work on real robots, and want your ideas to shape the direction of a programme, we want to hear from you.

This is an office-based role at our London site in Angel, Islington.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Integrate robots with XYZ’s software, bringing up ROS / ROS 2 interfaces, robot control, sensors, compute and data flows, and building repeatable tools for bring-up, configuration, logging and monitoring.

- Establish reliable baseline control and develop task-specific behaviours for navigation, positioning and capture, training and tuning control policies in simulation and validating them on hardware.

- Develop localisation-aware path planning, waypoint execution and obstacle handling, working with project and site teams to turn work plans and BIM-derived locations into robot missions.

- Integrate capture payloads so images, pose, timing and mission status flow reliably into XYZ’s construction progress workflows, working with navigation, SLAM and perception colleagues.

- Design test scenarios and measure mission completion, coverage, localisation quality, intervention, recovery and repeatability, improving the system through measured iterations.

- Bring technical expertise and new ideas to the programme, comparing scripted, motion-planning and learning-based approaches and helping shape what comes next.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

- MSc or PhD in Robotics, Controls, Computer Science, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent applied robotics experience. Industry experience is not required.

- Hands-on experience building, programming or directly controlling a physical robot, from an academic project, research lab or industry.

- Strong Python and C++, practical ROS experience (ideally ROS 2) and working knowledge of kinematics, coordinate frames, feedback control, state estimation, path planning and robot hardware.

- Experience training or tuning robot control policies (e.g. reinforcement or imitation learning) using NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim or similar tools, with a rigorous experimental approach.

- The right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS 

- ROS / ROS 2, Python & C++

- Robot control, kinematics, state estimation & path planning

- NVIDIA Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim, reinforcement or imitation learning

- Sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware (desirable)

- Navigation, SLAM, perception & sensor fusion (desirable)

- Mobile or field robotics, BIM/CAD or construction technology (desirable)

BENEFITS 

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays
🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station
🪙 Annual salary reviews
🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties
🍣 Free lunch on Thursdays, followed by after-work drinks
💰 Employee referral scheme
🚀 Make a real-world impact by helping transform the construction industry

title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
description:
AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.

Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.

The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.

What You'll Do: 

- Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.

- Define, measure and raise the quality of post-training data — basic correctness, representativeness against the real distribution of customer systems and production telemetry, and difficulty — and make those measures something the team can act on release over release.

- Close the realism gap. Simulated environments today are too clean and the injected problems are not yet hard enough; you'll drive the research and the engineering that make them look like real, imperfect production systems.

- Build scalable, production-grade systems rather than research scripts. The output is not just a dataset — it is a system of synthetic environments that must be reliable and invokable inside a training loop.

- Determine how this data is best applied, in LLM post-training and in evaluation, and own the agent and LLM application evaluation approaches for these environments.

- Work cross-functionally with the engineers and applied scientists on adjacent teams — Bits AI SRE, the model training effort, and the wider evaluation and experimentation pillar — so that what you learn moves freely in both directions.

Who You Are: 

- You have a PhD, MS or equivalent research experience in a scientific field, with strong applied mathematics grounding.

- 6+ years of relevant applied science or ML engineering experience, including setting technical direction for others.

- You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent post-training data: how it is created, managed, and how training-data quality is controlled. This is the requirement that matters most.

- You have real domain expertise in LLMs and agentic applications — not classical ML fine-tuning. Fine-tuning classifiers or traditional models is a different problem from the one this team is solving.

- You have evaluated agents or LLM applications, and can define what 'good' means before you measure it.

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. - 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

- Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

- Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

- Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

- Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

- Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

- Management experience

description:

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.

title: (Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)

About your new role

- GEO Strategy & Development: You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

- Technical GEO Optimization: You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. - Experimentation & Competitive Analysis: You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

- AI Shopping & Content Optimization: You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

- Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Product and Engineering initiatives and collaborate with Brand and Communications/PR on authority-building and digital PR opportunities. You actively share your expertise, communicate findings to stakeholders, and contribute insights from the evolving AI search landscape to idealo's long-term SEO strategy.

Skills & Requirements 

- 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a clear focus on technical SEO. 

- Strong technical SEO fundamentals: site architecture, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, JavaScript SEO, and experience running full technical audits. 

- Practical understanding of how generative search systems retrieve, summarize, and cite content.

- Experience with data analysis, KPI definition, and translating data into recommendations. 

- Hands-on proficiency with core SEO tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar crawler).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Bau die KI für eine Stadt, die einfach funktioniert. 

Ein Vorgang bleibt liegen, weil Wissen nur in einzelnen Köpfen steckt. Mitarbeitende suchen Informationen über mehrere Systeme hinweg. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben kosten Zeit, die für die Anliegen der Menschen fehlt.

Bei summ ai wollen wir das ändern. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Software für Prozessmanagement und Automatisierung im öffentlichen Sektor. Unser Ziel: Verwaltungswissen zugänglich machen, Abläufe vereinfachen und Routinearbeit automatisieren – mit Software, die Menschen gerne nutzen und die sich mit ihren Anforderungen weiterentwickelt.

Dafür arbeiten wir eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen. Wir verstehen ihre Probleme, bringen Lösungen früh in den Einsatz und verbessern sie anhand echter Nutzung. Als AI Engineer gestaltest du diesen Weg mit: von der Produktidee über die technische Umsetzung bis zur Frage, ob die KI im Alltag zuverlässig hilft.

Deine Aufgaben

- Probleme verstehen und Lösungen gestalten: Du sprichst direkt mit Kunden, hinterfragst Anforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, die du früh mit Nutzern überprüfst.

- KI-Funktionen und Agenten bauen: Du verantwortest die Umsetzung vom Interface bis zum Backend. Du verbindest Modelle mit Datenquellen und Werkzeugen und gestaltest Prompts, Kontext und Agentenabläufe.

- KI-Qualität verbessern: Du analysierst Fehler aus der Nutzung, baust Evaluationen auf und vergleichst Modelle hinsichtlich Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kosten. Du kannst zeigen, ob eine Änderung tatsächlich besser funktioniert.

- Bis in den Betrieb Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bringst Funktionen live, beobachtest ihre Nutzung und entwickelst sie weiter. Zu deiner Arbeit gehören auch Deployment, Monitoring und die nötige Cloud-Infrastruktur.

- Unsere Entwicklung voranbringen: Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge, automatisierst wiederkehrende Arbeit und hilfst dem Team, schneller zu verlässlichen Ergebnissen zu kommen.

Das bringst du mit

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und die Fähigkeit Funktionen Ende-zu-Ende umzusetzen.

- Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen oder Agenten.

- Erfahrung mit dem Betrieb von Anwendungen in der Cloud.

- Produktverständnis und Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt. Du möchtest mitentscheiden, was gebaut wird, und übernimmst Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.

- Einen durchdachten, pragmatischen Umgang mit Qualität: Du berücksichtigst Fehlerfälle und verstehst unter „fertig“, dass eine Funktion bei Kunden zuverlässig läuft.

- Neugier, Eigeninitiative und Interesse daran, den öffentlichen Sektor zu verbessern.

Eigene Projekte und Open-Source-Beiträge interessieren uns ebenfalls.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Viel Entscheidungsfreiheit und direkter Einfluss auf Produkt und Technik.

- Kurze Wege von einer Idee über Kundenfeedback bis zur Umsetzung.

- Raum zum Experimentieren und Lernen als Teil deiner Arbeit.

- Hybrides Arbeiten mit regelmäßigem Austausch vor Ort in München.

- Benefits wie Wellpass und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Zeig uns, was du gebaut hast. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich, deine Projekte und deine Überlegungen dahinter kennenzulernen.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have 

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

- Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

- Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for 

- Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

- Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

- Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

- Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

- Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance 

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Acoustic Researcher
description:
Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille) 

The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer.

Founded by Aymeric (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.

France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service.

Pelagon is backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised.

Why this matters 

The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem.

France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our Acoustic Researcher , you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define.

What you'll do 

- Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline.

- Characterize and classify acoustic signatures of surface and underwater targets; build the ground-truth understanding our multimodal acoustic model is trained against.

- Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors.

- Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models.

What we look for 

- Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience.

- Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theory, array processing, time-frequency analysis.

- Fluent in Python (NumPy/SciPy) for modeling, simulation and analysis; comfortable working with large datasets.

- A builder's instinct, you want your work deployed at sea, not left in a paper. Bias toward validating ideas against real data.

- Bonus: prior experience using machine learning on acoustic signals, naval / defense domain experience.

Why join now 

- Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that.

- A mission with weight. This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space.

- Real things, in the real ocean, fast. You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years.

- AI-first, at the edge, in the real world. We train our own models and run them where it counts: in the water, on the device. You'll be solving the edge-ML and power problems most companies only talk about.

- A sovereign, European deeptech at the inflection point of a market with strong NATO and EU policy momentum behind it.

title: Research Software Engineering Intern (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.

The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.

This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it.

- Keep the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions healthy as the framework grows: tests, linting, packaging, releases.

- Give first-pass reviews on pull requests from our engineers (tests, conventions, API conformance) before your mentor approves them.

- Help our engineers extend the stack: new measurement protocols become modules in the framework, and you validate the migrated ones on our QDm systems together with them.

- Document the framework and hand it over so the team runs it on its own after your internship.

What is expected of you 

- Enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in computer science, software engineering, computational engineering, physics or electrical engineering with a strong software focus.

- Available full time for 6 months, starting as soon as possible.

- Python is your working language: you structure packages, write type hints and tests, and have refactored or consolidated code you did not write.

- Git and CI are routine for you, and you know how to make hardware-dependent code testable: mocked instruments, recorded data and simulation, with runs on real hardware as a separate stage.

- AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

- You review code and take review well, you can agree on a common interface with engineers who each prefer their own solution, and you treat your colleagues as your users.

- Fluent in English. On-site in Munich.

Experience with instrument control or lab automation in Python, with frameworks such as qudi, QCoDeS or PyMeasure, or contributions to open-source projects are a plus, not required. What we want you to bring is the patience to read code you did not write and the discipline to leave it better structured than you found it.

Our benefits 

- Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

- Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

- Mentoring: An experienced colleague from the team mentors you throughout your internship.

- Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

- Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

- Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us 

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

Requirements

- Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints.

- A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.

- An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application.

- Exposure to the full development process , from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment.

- Practical experimental experience , supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities.

- Practical exposure to industrial R&D , including collaboration with laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.

- Meaningful impact , contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions, improve circularity and increase the performance of critical infrastructure.

title: Stagiair(e) AI Developer: bouw de MCP voor Upod
description:
Werk mee aan een nieuw internet. Niet als toeschouwer, maar als bouwer van de technische fundering.

Upod is net gelanceerd. De volgende stap: Upod toegankelijk maken voor AI-agents en LLM's, op een manier die privacy-first blijft. Daarvoor bouwen we een MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, en jij bouwt die mee, direct samen met ons tech team.

Utonomy ontwikkelt technologie gebaseerd op een nieuw protocol van de uitvinder van het world wide web (Solid, van Tim Berners-Lee) dat mensen weer controle geeft over hun persoonlijke data. Daarmee leggen we de basis voor privacy-first producten, eerlijke AI en een Europees alternatief voor Big Tech.

De grove richting van de MCP staat vast: AI-agents moeten op een veilige, privacy-respecterende manier met Upod-data kunnen werken. De concrete invulling, architectuur en scope bouwen we samen met jou uit.

Taken

Dit is geen meekijk-stage. Je bouwt mee aan een systeem dat nog niet bestaat, met directe begeleiding.

- Ontwerpen en bouwen van de MCP-server voor Upod, samen met Martijn (co-founder)

- Uitdenken van API-structuur, scopes en autorisatie, met privacy-by-design als uitgangspunt

- Testen van de MCP-integratie met LLM's en AI-agents

- Documenteren van architectuurkeuzes en implementatie

- Meedenken over de bredere toekomst van personal AI agents op Upod

Ideaal voor studenten informatica, AI, data science of software engineering met interesse in protocollen en API's.

Vereisten

Je bent een self-starter die goed gaat op:

- Het krijgen van vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid, met directe begeleiding van een founder

- Zelf meedenken over architectuur, niet alleen uitvoeren wat is opgeschreven

- Snel schakelen tussen zelfstandig bouwen en samen sparren

- Ruimte om te experimenteren, ook als iets de eerste keer niet werkt

We zoeken geen "perfect CV". Wel echte technische nieuwsgierigheid en de wil om iets nieuws te bouwen.

Je:

- volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in informatica, AI, data science of vergelijkbaar

- hebt ervaring met API's en minimaal één programmeertaal (bijvoorbeeld Python, TypeScript/Node)

- bent minimaal 5-6 maanden beschikbaar

- bent pro-actief, technisch nieuwsgierig en leergierig

- spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels

Benefits

Benefits

- Stagevergoeding (marktconform)

- Kantoor in hartje Utrecht + hybride werken

- Directe, inhoudelijke begeleiding, geen tussenlagen

- Echte verantwoordelijkheid over een technisch fundament, niet een side-project

- Netwerk en ervaring waar je jaren later nog profijt van hebt

- Kansen om na je stage betrokken te blijven

Waarom dit een uitzonderlijke stage is

- Je bouwt een technisch component dat bepaalt hoe AI straks met Upod werkt

- Je zit dicht op de besluitvorming, direct samen met de co-founder die dit begeleidt

- Je bouwt mee aan een nieuw protocol-ecosysteem, niet aan een geïsoleerde feature

- Je leert protocollen, architectuur en privacy-by-design in de praktijk, niet uit een tutorial

Geef in je motivatie aan:

- welke ervaring je al hebt met API's, protocollen of AI-integraties

- wanneer je kunt starten

- wat je wilt leren over MCP, AI-agents of privacy-by-design

Geen lange brief nodig, vertel ons vooral waarom jij dit wilt bouwen en wat je al hebt gebouwd.
