title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Impact 

- Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance

- Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows

- Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

- Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

- Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data

- Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

Your Profile 

- PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or

- Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience

- Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time

- Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation

- Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

- Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

- Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

- Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

- Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

- Excellent communication skills in English

Bonus Points 

- Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

- Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

- Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

- Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

- Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

- A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

title: Senior Software-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin - Hybrid
description:
Senior Software-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin 

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React. 

Auf einen Blick 

- Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

- Vertrag: unbefristet, Vollzeit

- Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

- Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)

- Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden

- Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle 

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

- Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

- Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

- Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

- Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

- Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

- Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten … 

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil 

- Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

- PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

- Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

- Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

- JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

- Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

- Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

- Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

- Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

- Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

- Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team 

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten 

- Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

- Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

- 30 Urlaubstage

- Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

- Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, z. B. Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

- Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

- Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

- UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

- Gute Anbindung: S1 und Busse M48, 101, 115

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess 

- Kennenlerngespräch mit Sara

- Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit Nico und Daniel

- Teamgespräch vor Ort

- Angebot

Über Girona 

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf unsere Lösungen, Konsentas etwa in Bürgerämtern, Gesundheitsämtern sowie Kfz-Zulassungs- und Führerscheinstellen.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer
description:
Data, software & technische toepassingen 

FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM 

Wil jij data en software inzetten voor een fysieke technologie die bijdraagt aan een energiezuinigere en duurzamere glastuinbouw? 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor hightech kassen. Onze projecten leveren uiteenlopende klimaat-, energie-, sensor- en productdata op. Deze data vormt de basis voor betrouwbare analyses, klantinzichten en verdere verbetering van onze technologie. 

We zoeken een Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer die sterke analytische vaardigheden combineert met praktische softwareontwikkeling. Je helpt een schaalbare data- en softwareomgeving op te bouwen: van data-inname en kwaliteitscontrole tot dashboards, analyseprocessen en technische tools. 

Je werkt niet op afstand van het fysieke product. Je werkt direct samen met engineers, onderzoekers en analisten aan toepassingen voor kas- en klantprojecten.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Data-infrastructuur en datakwaliteit 

Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt betrouwbare datastromen voor sensoren, technische systemen en andere relevante databronnen. 

Je structureert de opslag, verwerking en beschikbaarheid van project- en tijdreeksdata. 

Je ontwikkelt methoden om data uit verschillende systemen en formaten goed samen te brengen. 

Je automatiseert controles, monitoring en foutafhandeling. 

Je stelt praktische standaarden op voor datakwaliteit, documentatie, traceerbaarheid en versiebeheer. 

Je zorgt dat data bruikbaar en beschikbaar is voor analyses, dashboards, technische evaluaties en productontwikkeling. 

Je houdt rekening met passende toegang en bescherming van klantdata en interne kennis. 

Data-analyse en technische inzichten 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare analyseprocessen voor klimaat-, energie- en productdata. 

Je analyseert tijdreeksen en helpt verschillen tussen situaties, perioden en projecten te verklaren. 

Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van betrouwbare vergelijkingen, baselines en prestatieberekeningen. 

Je vertaalt statistische en technische resultaten naar duidelijke inzichten voor engineers en andere collega’s. 

Je beoordeelt en verbetert analyses van de Data Analyst. 

Je werkt samen met Performance en R&D om technische methoden om te zetten in betrouwbare analyses. 

Je bepaalt welke analyses geautomatiseerd kunnen worden en waar inhoudelijke interpretatie nodig blijft. 

Software en technische tools 

Je bouwt software waarmee technische teams projecten sneller en consistenter kunnen analyseren. 

Je ontwikkelt praktische tools voor berekeningen, scenarioanalyses, projectevaluaties en technische besluitvorming. 

Je zet prototypes en onderzoeksresultaten om in betrouwbare, onderhoudbare software. 

Je integreert relevante interne en externe rekenmethoden in bruikbare toepassingen. 

Je ontwikkelt waar relevant koppelingen met externe systemen en platforms. 

Je werkt mee aan zowel de technische achterkant als gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces. 

Je zorgt dat technische kennis op een veilige en beheersbare manier in software wordt toegepast. 

Dashboards en rapportages 

Je ontwikkelt interne en klantgerichte dashboards voor het monitoren en evalueren van projecten. 

Je bouwt duidelijke visualisaties van klimaatomstandigheden, energiegebruik en productprestaties. 

Je automatiseert terugkerende rapportages met behoud van traceerbare berekeningen en aannames. 

Je zorgt dat dashboards en rapportages begrijpelijk zijn voor engineers, telers en commerciële collega’s. 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare rapportages voor verschillende typen projecten en klanten. 

Je bewaakt dat klantgerichte resultaten aansluiten op de onderliggende gevalideerde methoden. 

Technisch eigenaarschap en begeleiding 

Je maakt technische keuzes die passen bij een groeiende organisatie en toekomstige opschaling. 

Je introduceert praktische standaarden voor softwareontwikkeling, documentatie, testen en versiebeheer. 

Je begeleidt de Data Analyst of werkstudent en beoordeelt complexere analyses en ontwikkelwerkzaamheden. 

Je helpt software- en datawerk te prioriteren op basis van behoeften vanuit klantprojecten, engineering en productontwikkeling. 

Je bepaalt wanneer een snelle analyse voldoende is en wanneer een schaalbare softwareoplossing nodig is. 

Je werkt waar nodig samen met externe specialisten. 

Je helpt de bredere Data & Software-functie binnen Thermeleon op te bouwen. 

Hoe werk je samen met de andere functies? 

Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead Application & Systems Engineer en de Data Analyst. 

De Lead Application & Systems Engineer bepaalt welke klant- en engineeringvragen moeten worden beantwoord. 

Jij vertaalt die vragen naar passende data-, analyse- en softwareoplossingen. 

De Data Analyst ondersteunt bij datavoorbereiding, analyses, dashboarding, monitoring en rapportages. 

Performance en R&D ontwikkelen en valideren technische methoden en onderliggende kennis. 

Jij vertaalt deze methoden naar betrouwbare analyseprocessen en bruikbare software. 

Productontwikkeling en Hardware leveren technische vereisten en productinformatie. 

Samen zorgen jullie dat projectdata wordt omgezet in inzichten, klantwaarde en productverbeteringen. 

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid van de data- en software-implementatie. Performance en R&D blijven verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke validatie van technische methoden. De Lead Application & Systems Engineer blijft verantwoordelijk voor de toepassing in het geïntegreerde klantadvies.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken we? 

Je hebt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in computer science, data science, engineering, toegepaste wiskunde, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. 

Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering of technische data-analyse. 

Je hebt sterke Python-vaardigheden en ervaring met het bouwen van onderhoudbare software- of analysetoepassingen. 

Je hebt ervaring met tijdreeksdata, API’s, databases en dataverwerking. 

Je hebt ervaring met back-endontwikkeling en met het opleveren van praktische interfaces of dashboards. 

Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt je verdiepen in fysieke en operationele systemen. 

Je kunt verkennende analyses en prototypes omzetten in robuuste, herbruikbare oplossingen. 

Je kunt pragmatische technische keuzes maken binnen een groeiende organisatie. 

Je beheerst het Engels professioneel. Nederlands is waardevol, maar geen vereiste. 

Je kunt technische keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan collega’s zonder softwareachtergrond. 

Extra waardevol 

Ervaring met data uit energie, industrie, gebouwtechnologie, glastuinbouw of IoT. 

Kennis van statistiek, experimenteel ontwerp en onzekerheidsanalyse. 

Ervaring met cloudinfrastructuur, geautomatiseerd testen en deployment. 

Ervaring met Python, SQL en relevante data- en visualisatietools. 

Ervaring met tijdreeks- en sensordata. 

Ervaring met het omzetten van technische of wetenschappelijke rekenmethoden naar softwaretoepassingen. 

Ervaring met het begeleiden van junior analisten of ontwikkelaars. 

Interesse in thermodynamica, energiesystemen of glastuinbouw. 

Je past waarschijnlijk goed bij ons als je 

Graag werkt op het snijvlak van data-analyse en softwareontwikkeling. 

Wilt dat je werk invloed heeft op een fysiek product en echte klantprojecten. 

Structuur kunt aanbrengen in data en systemen die nog in ontwikkeling zijn. 

Zowel analytische correctheid als bruikbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid belangrijk vindt. 

Minder ervaren collega’s graag helpt zich te ontwikkelen. 

Praktische tools wilt bouwen die daadwerkelijk binnen projecten worden gebruikt.

Benefits

Wat bieden we? 

Een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling van onze data- en softwareomgeving. 

Een brede functie waarin data engineering, analyse, software en productontwikkeling samenkomen. 

Directe betrokkenheid bij fysieke systemen en praktijkprojecten. 

De mogelijkheid om technische keuzes, standaarden en werkwijzen mede te bepalen. 

Samenwerking met engineers, onderzoekers, telers en technologiepartners. 

De mogelijkheid om collega’s te begeleiden en de Data & Software-functie verder op te bouwen. 

Een passend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket op basis van je ervaring. 

Een hybride werkomgeving rond ons kantoor in Rotterdam.

Over Thermeleon 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor de glastuinbouw. Met onze technologie helpen we telers hun fossiele warmtevraag, energiekosten en CO₂-uitstoot te verlagen. 

We werken samen met telers, kennisinstellingen en technologiepartners om onze technologie verder te ontwikkelen, te valideren en toe te passen. Binnen Thermeleon werk je direct aan de verbinding tussen fysieke technologie, software, data en de praktijk in de kas.

You will translate novel research ideas into production-quality code, build and maintain the data pipelines and modeling infrastructure that underpin our strategies, and apply your own strong mathematical intuition to solve open-ended technical challenges.

This role lives at the boundary of research and engineering. You will be expected to understand the statistical and mathematical concepts your research partners work with, contribute meaningfully to technical discussions about model design and evaluation, and ensure that the resulting systems are performant, reliable, and maintainable. Requirements

- Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems design)

- Demonstrated mathematical maturity — comfort with the concepts and notation used in statistics, linear algebra, optimization, and probability

- Deep proficiency in Python; experience with R and/or C/C++ is a strong plus

- Extensive experience with numerical and data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar)

- Proven experience building or maintaining machine learning systems in a distributed computing environment

- Proficiency developing in a Linux environment with attention to performance, correctness, and reproducibility

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly when working with imperfect or heterogeneous data

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers whose primary expertise is not software engineering

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with performance profiling and optimization of numerical or modeling code

- Prior exposure to financial data, time-series analysis, or quantitative research environments

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

- Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
- Youâre hungry to learn more
- Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate
The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Monthly team events and activities
- Weekly team lunches
- Casual dress code
- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

- Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
- Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view
- What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?

2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job:

- If you donât have one, explain why.
- If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere.
3. Upload your cover letter and resume

- Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the âApply Nowâ button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!***

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

What You Will Do

- 
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

- 
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

- 
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

- 
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

- 
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

- 
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

- 
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

- 
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

- 
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

- 
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

- 
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

- 
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

- 
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

- 
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

- 
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- 
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

- 
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

- 
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

- 
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

- 
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, KServe, or related projects.

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius: 

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Head of Investment Fund Operations

You will work closely with internal stakeholders as well as fund administrators, system providers, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. As a member of the Valuation Committee, you will also contribute your expertise to fund valuation-related decisions.

The position offers a combination of team leadership, fund operations expertise, data management, regulatory knowledge and process automation , with considerable scope to improve existing processes and further professionalise the operational setup.

Location: Basel

Your Responsibilities: 

- Manage and develop a team of three Fund Operations specialists and oversee operations for the complete Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- Ensure the availability, integrity and quality of fund data across the relevant internal systems

- Monitor end-to-end data flows and act as the key contact for the external system provider

- Manage the relationship with CACEIS concerning NAV data, including plausibility controls and the investigation and resolution of discrepancies

- Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, automation and data quality

Your Profile: 

- At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in fund operations, fund controlling, fund accounting, fund administration or fund audit

- Comprehensive knowledge of the Swiss and Luxembourg fund landscape, ideally including CISA, FINMA, AMAS, UCITS and CSSF regulations

- Previous leadership or people management experience is an advantage

- High level of integrity, reliability and accountability

- Comfortable working in an international, regulated financial services environment

- University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

- Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

- A senior position with broad responsibility for the operational management of a Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- The opportunity to shape and further improve the Fund Operations function and its processes

- A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

- Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

- The opportunity to contribute to the Valuation Committee and support important fund-related decisions

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. Acme | Remote / In-person (flexible) | Full-time | Founding Full-Stack Engineer Acme is building a product. We are an early-stage company at the ground floor — no code yet, no customers yet, just a clear vision and a bias for action. We are looking for a founding engineer who wants to build something from nothing: architect the system, write the first line of code, ship the first version, and grow alongside the company. - Build the product end-to-end — from database schema and API design to frontend UI and deployment infrastructure

- Ship iteratively — get working software in front of users fast, then improve based on real feedback
- Set engineering standards — establish coding conventions, code review practices, and a culture of quality

- Own the infrastructure — provision cloud resources, manage deployments, and keep the app running in production Who You Are:
- 3–8 years of software engineering experience, preferably in early-stage startups or with significant side-project shipping
- Full-stack capable — comfortable across frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure

- Independent — thrive without a playbook. Figure things out, make decisions, communicate clearly
- High ownership, low ego — care about the mission and the team, not about who gets credit
- Product-sensible — good judgment about what users need and what can wait Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity (2–5% range) How to Apply: Send a note to the CEO with what excites you about early-stage building, a link to something you have built (GitHub, portfolio, side project), and why Acme specifically. title: Senior Software Engineer, Product
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role 

We’re looking for a Product oriented Fullstack Engineer to design, build, ship, and own end-to-end product features used by thousands of developers and hundreds of millions of end-users.

We’re specifically looking for someone with a strong backend foundation who is also genuinely proficient in React.

This is a hands-on IC role. We are looking for someone product-focused, but deeply technical. You’ll work across frontend, backend, and data boundaries, making thoughtful tradeoffs to deliver reliable, high-quality systems. You’ll take ownership from problem definition through production rollout and long-term maintenance, the scoping and prioritization work as much as the code.

“Product-focused” at RevenueCat means pairing strong engineering fundamentals with good judgment, customer obsession, and a bias toward shipping — not trading correctness, reliability, or scalability for speed, but also not letting “perfect” get in the way of “shipped today.”

About You 

- 
You have 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend foundation and a track record of building and operating high-scale production systems.

- 
You can write advanced SQL statements beyond basic SELECT and UPDATE statements.

- 
You’re proficient in React and have genuinely built on the frontend before. You’re comfortable owning UI work, not just backend APIs.

- 
You have solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals, and an understanding of HTTP and browser–server interactions

- 
You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

- 
You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

- 
You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

- 
You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

- 
You're comfortable coding alongside AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. You use them to move faster on the parts that don't need your full attention, and you're detail-oriented enough to catch when they're wrong.

- 
You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

- 
You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

- 
You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

- 
You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

- 
You act like an founder:: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

Technologies you’ll likely work with: 

- 
TypeScript

- 
React

- 
PostgreSQL

- 
Python

- 
Flask

- 
AWS-hosted systems, following best practices for deployment, monitoring, and reliability

A note: Our interview process includes two separate live-coding sessions: one on frontend fundamentals and one on SQL, data logic, and algorithmic programming. We've found strength in both is a strong predictor of success in this role.

In the first month, you’ll: 

- 
Meet frequently with your team and manager to get up to speed.

- 
Get familiar with our tools, processes, and core subscription-business concepts.

- 
Complete a First Ship project.

- 
Jump in early: fix bugs, ship small improvements, and weigh in on PRs.

Within the first 3 months, you’ll: 

- 
Have shipped a medium-sized project successfully.

- 
Understand the main product areas your team owns and how they work end to end.

- 
Scope and work on projects self-sufficiently, from idea to post-launch improvements.

- 
Actively participate in code reviews, bug bashes, and technical discussions.

- 
Continuously improve areas of your team’s codebase and product.

Within the first 6 months, you’ll: 

- 
Become the go-to engineer for certain focus areas.

- 
Proactively contribute to architecture discussions that impact more than just your team.

- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, and data; communicate clearly during incidents; drive fixes that prevent repeats.

- 
Engage directly with customers to understand how your work actually lands.

- 
Mentor other engineers joining the team and raise the bar through feedback and guidance.

Within the first 12 months, you’ll: 

- 
Know all the major components of our system and be able to debug complex issues across it.

- 
Spec and architect large projects, gather feedback, and drive design validation and rollout plans.

- 
Lead your own initiatives for improving our product and systems, grounded in real customer and business priorities.

What we offer: 

- 
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

- 
10-year window to exercise vested equity options

- 
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

- 
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

- 
Paid desk at a co-working space

- 
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat 

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work: 

- 
How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team 

- 
The values that guide how we work: Our Values 

- 
How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat 

- 
What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations 

- 
What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role 

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to design, build, ship, and own end-to-end product features used by thousands of developers and hundreds of millions of end-users.

This is a hands-on IC role. We want someone that loves shipping products, not just code. You are an engineer obsessed with the customer and passionate about software. You’ll take ownership from problem scoping to production rollout to long-term maintenance. You have both the engineering fundamentals to write performant systems that operate at huge scale near flawlessly and the product sense that doesn't let “perfect” get in the way of “shipped today.”

About You 

- 
You have 8+ years of experience as a backend engineer designing complex, fast-growing systems that didn't exist before you.

- 
You can write advanced SQL statements beyond basic SELECT and UPDATE statements.

- 
You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

- 
You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

- 
You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

- 
You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

- 
You're comfortable coding alongside AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. You use them to move faster on the parts that don't need your full attention, and you're detail-oriented enough to catch when they're wrong.

- 
You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

- 
You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

- 
You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

- 
You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

- 
You act like a founder: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

Ideally, you have: 

- 
Experience in Python.

- 
Experience in PostgreSQL.

- 
Experience building SDKs.

- 
Shipped a mobile app with in-app purchases.

- 
Some experience with React and SPA applications.

In the first month, you'll: 

- 
Meet frequently with your team and mentor to get up to speed.

- 
Set up and get familiar with repositories, task management, and the dev environment.

- 
Implement and ship your first project.

- 
Get familiar with RevenueCat’s dashboards, logging, debugging tools, cloud providers, infrastructure, and general architecture.

- 
Learn about the mobile app economy and subscription-business concepts that shape our product decisions.

Within the first 3 months, you'll 

- 
Scope and work on projects self-sufficiently, end to end.

-

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

About Supabase 


Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



About the role


We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform.


This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities.


What you'll work on 



- 
New OrioleDB features. Design and implement new capabilities in OrioleDB — for example, native index access methods (GiST, GIN, HNSW for pgvector), disaster recovery tooling, and other storage-engine-level features that expand what OrioleDB can do.




- 
Stability. Strengthen OrioleDB's reliability through deeper test coverage, fault injection, crash and recovery testing, and improvements to CI infrastructure. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios.




- 
Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community.
